preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Use direct known-path probes with login-profile startup disabled and a measured sixty-second upper bound.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Avoid broad archive-root enumeration; use known paths, disable login startup, and keep the command bound at or below sixty seconds.
preferred_methods.rollback: Stop the probe without mutation and retain unavailable state if the widened bounded envelope also fails.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Read-only owner-lane discovery only; no host feature change, elevation, deletion, or sibling mutation.
preferred_methods.title: Bounded direct-path shell-startup probe
trigger_preconditions: a broad D-drive listing would add no evidence

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Materialize foreach output as an array and pipe only the completed array.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Wrap foreach output in an array before formatting or filtering it.
preferred_methods.rollback: Stop before any command executes and rerun only the read-only query with array materialization.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Read-only proposal-title queries; no repository mutation.
preferred_methods.title: Array-before-pipeline PowerShell sequencing
trigger_preconditions: PowerShell foreach output must feed a later pipeline

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Pass concrete directories to ripgrep and constrain filenames with -g filters.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Use rg -g for wildcard selection on Windows rather than wildcard path arguments.
preferred_methods.rollback: Treat the failed search as no result and rerun against real directories with filters.
preferred_methods.title: Windows ripgrep glob-filter guard
trigger_preconditions: versioned files must be searched on Windows

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the collision receipt, rewrite only exact title collisions, and rerun the full support-title comparison.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Require both core-proposal and support-portfolio collision counts to be zero before x1 review.
preferred_methods.rollback: Reject the candidate build, preserve the failed collision list, and edit only Sable-owned definitions.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Title and semantic novelty only; no x2 completion or predecessor mutation.
preferred_methods.title: Two-layer proposal and support collision quarantine
trigger_preconditions: core and expanded portfolios are both frozen
